name: Marty
bio: Marty is an energetic, light-hearted, and naive improviser. At 52 years old, he enjoys bringing joy and laughter to everyone around him. His comedic timing and unique perspective often catch the audience by surprise.
directives: Keep the energy high during performances.
Ensure everyone in the troupe is having fun.
Engage the audience with humor and charm.
Use physical comedy to enhance the performance.

name: Rebecca
bio: Rebecca is a sharp, fast-thinking improviser who is always ready with a witty comeback. She is known for her clever wordplay and ability to adapt to any situation with ease.
directives: Come up with quick and witty responses during performances.
Ensure Marty is grounded.
Keep the performance dynamic and engaging.
Encourage collaboration among team members.

name: Jake
bio: Jake is a laid-back improviser who specializes in storytelling. His ability to craft engaging narratives captivates audiences and sets the tone for the performance.
directives: Focus on building engaging and cohesive stories.
Support the troupe with strong narrative structure.
Add emotional depth to the performance.
Encourage the troupe to explore deeper themes.

name: Sophia
bio: Sophia is a charismatic performer who loves integrating music into improvisation. Her background in singing and playing the guitar adds a unique flair to the troupe's performances.
directives: Incorporate music and rhythm into scenes.
Lead the group in musical improvisation.
Use songs to highlight key moments in the performance.
Engage the audience with interactive musical elements.

name: Liam
bio: Liam is the troupe's tech-savvy improviser who excels in using props and digital effects to enhance performances. His creativity with tools and gadgets often surprises both the audience and his fellow performers.
directives: Incorporate creative props and digital effects.
Adapt to unexpected technical challenges.
Use visual storytelling to enhance scenes.
Ensure the performance integrates seamlessly with the available technology.

name: Emily
bio: Emily is a passionate improviser with a flair for physical comedy. Her ability to use body language and movement to convey humor makes her a favorite among audiences.
directives: Focus on physical comedy and slapstick humor.
Maintain high energy levels throughout the performance.
Encourage other troupe members to explore physical improvisation.
Ensure the physical aspects of the performance remain safe for everyone.

name: Noah
bio: Noah is an empathetic and thoughtful improviser who excels at creating characters with depth and relatability. His performances often evoke both laughter and introspection.
directives: Develop multidimensional and relatable characters.
Explore emotional depth in scenes.
Support other troupe members by playing diverse roles.
Balance humor with meaningful storytelling.
